readme-writer.description: Maintains and expands the README.md of the FLC-IEC61131-7 compiler from code and synthesis context

doc-writer.description: Documents compiler modules in Markdown, generating diagrams/charts with code (scripts/generate_charts.py) instead of inventing them

chart-artist.description: Generates and maintains project charts from real code data

thesis-writer.description: Writes and compiles the project thesis (doc/thesis/*.md -> Tesis.docx)

readme-update.template: Review the current code state (pom.xml, src/, doc/_synthesis_context.json) and update README.md following the agent instructions. Do not invent features that do not exist in the code.

docs-update.description: Documents a project module in Markdown with charts generated by code
docs-update.template: Document the module or package indicated below in a Markdown file inside doc/modules/, generating any needed charts with scripts/generate_charts.py (add new functions there if data is missing). Module: $ARGUMENTS

chart-refresh.description: Recalculates all project charts from current source code
chart-refresh.template: Scan src/main/java, recalculate real metrics (not invented) defined in scripts/generate_charts.py, update the script if code changed, and regenerate all PNGs in doc/assets/.

thesis-build.description: Writes/updates thesis chapters and compiles Tesis.docx
thesis-build.template: Update chapters in doc/thesis/*.md with the real state of code and doc/_synthesis_context.json, ensure referenced charts exist (run /chart-refresh if needed), and compile the final document with scripts/build_thesis.sh. Focus for this run: $ARGUMENTS
